documentation_only_keys_note: Keys that are DELIBERATELY descriptive: measured provenance, null-result records, and fields RULES_SPEC.md section 10 defines as part of the config's documented shape. They are listed here so the gate's own dead-config detector can tell them apart from keys that read as live rules and are not. src_rules_note: Which rules read the SRC normalization (the tokenize-joined string runs of the property's own generators). Scoped per Ruling B 2026-09-17: NOT R3's T1/T2 numeral halves, because the generators embed the citation registry's own deliberately-kept dollar figures (DCI 7786ce5 records why the registry keeps them) and a $-anchored or bare-numeral scan over them would flood with figures that are correct where they sit. R3's T3 rank-claim half DOES read SRC, because 'the largest rebate' lived in _generate_service_pages.py CROSS_CONTEXT['attic'] and shipped to six pages from there. R7 half A (identifiers) also stays off SRC: the 2026-09-07 four-repo sweep measured DCI 62 / LGM 64 hits for the superseded print codes of which only NINE were live defects.

R2.corrective_disclosure_markers_reason: R2 measured 100%/82.7%/79.6% false positives with ZERO true positives, and the headline example was insulation-johnstown.html: 'in Johnstown the natural gas utility is Xcel Energy, not Atmos Energy' -- correct territory copy -- flagged as utility-not-serving-town. A hit is cleared when one of these governs the flagged name within 34 chars AND the sentence also names a utility that DOES serve the scope.
R2.clause_denial_markers_reason: A clause that DENIES a binding is the compliant form, not the defect. Measured 2026-09-18: LGM's "Longmont's situation (a second, Longmont Power & Communications-only rebate) doesn't apply in Lafayette." was failed 6 times by the nearest-binding resolver for naming the utility and the town in one clause -- while saying exactly what R2 exists to require. A rule that returns the same verdict for a claim and its denial is not testing the claim.
R2.electric_distinguishing_markers_reason: A sentence that DISTINGUISHES the gas utility from the electric one, or denies that electrical work qualifies, is the compliant statement sub-test 'e' exists to require -- not the defect. Measured 2026-09-18: all 10 of GCI's adjudicated `e` findings were sentences of exactly that shape, including "In Greeley the gas utility runs the insulation rebates, not the electric utility" and "The electrical work itself doesn't qualify for the Atmos Energy insulation rebate". Zero true positives.

R3.cost_unit_markers_reason: A per-unit marker is NOT sufficient on its own. LGM's cost_context_markers listed 'per square foot' while Efficiency Works DENOMINATES ITS PAYOUT per square foot, and that one marker removed 103 of the 133 banned figures (65 x $1.16 and 38 x $0.77). These require a cost noun from cost_noun_markers in the same window.
R3.year_payout_binders_reason: A four-digit number in 1900-2099 is cleared as a year UNLESS one of these sits within 40 chars. Requiring a DATE word instead was measurably worse: DCI R3 went 68 -> 237 adjudicated, 162 of them the bare year in 'the 2026 Xcel rebate programs', because a year needs no date word to be a year. The residual blind spot -- a bare rebate amount between 1900 and 2099 with no binder -- is printed in the filter label every run rather than hidden.
R3.code_noun_markers_reason: code_context_markers had become the blanket pardon f_pub used to be: naming ENERGY STAR anywhere in a sentence cleared any uncited statistic in it, through a filter whose stated purpose is CODE CONTEXT. 'ENERGY STAR homes differ, but our crews measure a 35% reduction in heating costs' was pardoned by it. The marker must now sit within 60 chars of the figure AND one of these nouns must be present, so the marker has to actually govern the number.
R3.money_words_note: 'dollars' was absent, which is what left R3-C4b and C17 open: a figure described in a dollars window was not in a money window at all.

R4.program_set_anaphora_reason: A phrase that stands for two or more programs WITHOUT naming any of them. R4's two-distinct-programs precondition had nothing to count on LGM's knob-and-tube page -- 'either insulation rebate program' in sentence 1, 'rebate stacking' three sentences later -- so every stacking token fired, the sentence reached RAW on both surfaces, and it was cleared with programs=-. GATE_SCORE_2026-09-17.md MISS 5. The phrase supplies the COUNT, never a name, and a hit resolved this way is classified ASSERTS-SET / DENIES-SET so the loosening is visible in every enumeration and carries its own control.

R5.publisher_short_forms_note: POSSESSIVE short forms of names already in recognised_publishers, read ONLY by the publisher-as-subject predicate (_pub_subject) and NEVER by the proximity path. public/llms.txt writes 'the before-and-after 20% CFM50 reduction Xcel's air sealing rebate requires' and the word-bounded matcher cannot see 'Xcel Energy' in it. The bare token 'Xcel' is deliberately NOT here and must never be added to recognised_publishers: on this portfolio Xcel is the PAYER on almost every page, and naming it in the proximity path is precisely the false clear the attribution-verb requirement was added to close. The possessive form is required because it makes the publisher the OWNER of the noun phrase that then carries the verb.
R5.publisher_artifact_nouns_note: The HEAD NOUN a possessive publisher may own before its verb, in the publisher-as-subject predicate. It used to be four words of anything, and the seventh adversarial read showed those four words become the real subject: 'ENERGY STAR's CRITICS say our 43% savings number is invented' and 'ENERGY STAR's LAWYERS say our 58% savings claim is actionable' both satisfied publisher-as-subject. Critics and lawyers are not the publisher. This list is the kinds of thing an organisation ISSUES and can therefore be quoted from, so an attribution has to point at a document rather than at somebody standing near one. A vocabulary, not a rule, which is why it is config.
R5.subject_attribution_verbs_note: Verbs that, with a recognised publisher as their SUBJECT, attribute the figure in their complement. DELIBERATELY SEPARATE FROM R1.attribution_verbs: 'estimates' was probed into that list and silently cleared 'ENERGY STAR estimates vary, but our crews measure a 35% reduction in heating costs', because R1's list is consumed by a PROXIMITY test that does not care which noun the verb belongs to. Read only by _pub_subject, which requires subject-verb adjacency and refuses to cross a clause boundary. 'pays' and 'rebates' are deliberately absent: those are what a PAYER does, and the payer-as-publisher confusion is a closed defect that must stay closed.
R5.magnitude_patterns_note: '40 percent' in DIGITS matched no pattern even after 'forty percent' was added as words -- a regex gap, not paraphrase. R5-E1.

claim_subjects.slot_scope_note: THE ONLY SUBJECT IN THIS LIST WHOSE extract TOKENS CARRY NONE OF ITS OWN SUBJECT. Every other subject extracts on something that names it -- 'CFM 50', 'vermiculite', 'rim joist', 'pre-1990', 'qualifying measure', 'rebate', 'audit'. This one extracts on 'front door', 'precondition' and 'prerequisite', which are ordinary English. Its `required` slot pattern was the bare string 'is the prerequisite step', naming neither an audit nor the WHE Bonus, so it bound DCI ba2fc22's vermiculite-removal-cost-denver.html sentence -- 'the identification guide is the prerequisite step', about whether a homeowner should test their attic before reading a removal-cost page -- to the proposition that an energy audit is a precondition of the Whole Home Efficiency Bonus, and failed the build on a contradiction that did not exist. Same class as the R4 repair at 86b4ffd: a pattern that imports its meaning from whatever sentence happens to contain the words. THE FIX IS ON THE SLOT PATTERN, NOT ON A SENTENCE-WIDE `context` GUARD. A context guard was tried first at c660a1d and is MEASURABLY WORSE: it required the sentence to contain 'audit' or a WHE token, and the probe 'An energy assessment is a prerequisite for the bonus, and Xcel will not pay it without one' -- a real paraphrase of the exact defect -- walked straight through it (R9 RAW 1 ADJ 1, missed, against RAW 2 ADJ 2 on the parent commit). Qualifying the one offending pattern instead gives RAW 1 ADJ 1 on real DCI copy (the false positive stays dead, identical result) and RAW 2 ADJ 2 with that probe injected (still caught). Same cure, no loss of coverage. RESIDUAL, STATED: 'is a prerequisite for' is still subject-free and could bind an unrelated 'X is a prerequisite for Y'. It is KEPT unqualified deliberately, because it is the pattern that catches the 'energy assessment' paraphrase; no instance of it misfires on any of the three properties today.

R10.refusal_markers_reason: EXTENDED 2026-09-18. R10's own declared bias is that a destination which refuses IN WORDS THE CONFIG DOES NOT KNOW looks like a destination with no figures, and that the failure mode is a false positive rather than a false negative. Both of GCI's adjudicated R10 findings were exactly that: insulation-attic-greeley.html refuses four different ways -- 'publishes the amount', 'publishes the current amount on its own rebate page', 'publishes its own insulation and air sealing rebate terms', and 'publishes a Greeley-specific installed price per square foot, and this site is not going to invent one' -- and carries zero dollar figures (measured: /usr/bin/grep -oIE '[$][0-9][0-9,.]*' returns 0, against a control of 60 for 'Greeley'). The bias is right and the wording list was short.

false_positive_measurements._README: A rule measured above demote_above_pct false positives becomes REPORT-ONLY: it stops affecting the exit code and prints its measured rate in its own output every run. A rule at two thirds false positives will be ignored by every future session, and a rule that is ignored while still red manufactures the appearance of coverage while providing none. The measurement is DATA -- it lives here so the next pass RE-TAKES it rather than inheriting it. Re-measure exhaustively (every finding on every property, never sampled) and delete the entry when the rate drops, which is what happened to R2 in this same pass: 100% / 79.5% / >90% as found, 0% after the causes were fixed, so R2 is NOT listed here and stays blocking.

R3.note: Every adjudicated R3 finding on every property was classified; nothing was sampled. The TRUE nine are all T3 rebate-magnitude rank claims: the capped-per-measure sentence ("Xcel rebates ... are capped per measure, so the larger the job, the smaller the percentage") and the cooling-only tier sentence ("Customers with cooling-only Xcel service get a much smaller flat tier"). T1, the $-anchored half, is EXACT and is the reason this demotion is recorded per RULE rather than silently deleting the rule: T1 matched the human sweep 198/198 on DCI and 206/206 on GCI in the 2026-09-17 replay. Demoting R3 wholesale is the conservative reading of the standing 25% ruling and it costs T1's blocking power; the next pass should split the verdict per sub-type so T1 can block while T3 reports.
